title: Buchhalter (m/w/d)
description: Welcome to Panda Parken – one of Europe’s fastest-growing airport parking providers. With a motivated team, we are expanding Panda Parken across Europe, and we are looking for high-potential individuals like you to join us. To support our continued growth, we are seeking a structured, numbers-driven, and hands-on Accountant (m/f/d). Your Role: As an Accountant, you will work closely with our Finance & Admin Lead, assisting with general ledger accounting and process optimization.
responsibilities: Independently handling day-to-day accounting; executing and preparing weekly payment runs; account reconciliations; bank postings and petty cash management; handling VAT returns and tax authority filings; assisting with budget planning and financial analysis; reconciling and booking intercompany transactions (Austria, Switzerland, Slovenia); assisting with the preparation and execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements (under Austrian GAAP/UGB); actively contributing to the digitalization and optimization of accounting processes.
benefits: Attractive compensation starting at €3,500 gross (depending on qualifications and experience), Flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths, Company mobile phone & laptop, Additional benefits: Free airport parking, coffee, snacks & weekly lunch ☕, plus regular team events

title: Financial Accounting & Advisory (w/m/d)
description: Our 45-strong Financial Accounting & Advisory team, led by Martina Geisler, develops sustainable financial solutions for national and international clients. We focus on projects involving accounting standards (IFRS & UGB), reporting, digitalization, AI in finance, and system or process optimization. Together, the team supports clients with future-oriented finance and transformation initiatives. At all our locations, you can expect a modern environment with flexible workspaces—designed to foster productivity, team spirit, and daily collaboration.
requirements: Completed degree in Business Administration or Economics with a specialization in accounting and/or controlling, Passion for numbers and economic concepts, combined with strong analytical thinking skills, German proficiency at a minimum C1 level and English proficiency at a minimum B2 level, Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel. Initial professional experience or internships in accounting or controlling
responsibilities: Actively participate in the implementation of new accounting standards and the creation of accounting manuals and technical position papers, Optimize financial processes, support digital projects, and implement innovative reporting solutions within the team, Address complex accounting issues, particularly those related to corporate transactions, Review and prepare annual and consolidated financial statements under UGB, IFRS, and US GAAP, Assist with special audits and contribute to a wide range of national and international projects
benefits: Flexibility in your daily routine: Options such as working from home, workations, sabbaticals, and flexible working hour models allow you to tailor your workday to your needs. Mobility: We cover public transport costs and offer additional benefits like bike leasing to make your commute to the office easier. Active feedback culture: Regular feedback sessions, clear development goals, and transparent performance reviews support your career path at EY. Professional development: A wide range of training, coaching, and learning opportunities supports your professional and personal growth. Wellbeing: Offerings such as free psychological counseling, coaching options, and mental health support initiatives boost your personal wellbeing. Sports & balance: A discounted myClubs subscription—providing access to diverse sports and leisure activities—helps you maintain a healthy work-life balance. "Bring a Friend": Your network pays off—referrals are rewarded with a bonus. Future skills & digitalization: Continuous upskilling through Copilot, training sessions, and our Copilot development network. The starting salary for this position is EUR 3,100 (excluding "all-in" contracts). Your actual salary will depend on your professional experience and qualifications. The principle of "Equal Pay for Equal Work" always applies.

title: Accounting Expert / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d)
description: Storebox is Europe’s first fully digital self-storage and logistics solution. With over 360 locations across more than 180 cities, Storebox is one of the fastest-growing tech companies. Together, we are solving the challenges of urbanization and shaping the future of logistics. Do you want to contribute your ideas to a rapidly growing scale-up and work in an environment where you can actively help shape things? Become part of our success story as an Accounting Expert / Financial Accountant (m/f/d).
requirements: Completed degree in Business Administration or Economics with a specialization in accounting and/or controlling, Passion for numbers and economic concepts, combined with strong analytical thinking skills, German proficiency at a minimum C1 level and English proficiency at a minimum B2 level, Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel. Initial professional experience or internships in accounting or controlling
responsibilities: Professional qualifications: Successfully completed certification as a balance sheet accountant (Bilanzbuchhalter) plus several years of professional experience in financial accounting, OR an accounting certification with relevant experience combined with a completed Bachelor’s degree specializing in Finance, Accounting, or Controlling. Process and improvement mindset: You actively contribute to the ongoing optimization of internal processes and genuinely enjoy developing existing workflows with a future-oriented approach. Solution-oriented team player: A structured way of working, strong teamwork skills, and a positive, solution-oriented mindset—even during dynamic or challenging phases. Motivation and drive to shape things: High level of commitment, a strong sense of ownership, and the motivation to independently get to grips with new topics in order to actively help shape the finance function at Storebox. Tool experience is a plus: Solid knowledge of the accounting software BMD is a distinct advantage.
benefits: Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model. Flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and a unique team spirit; subsidized lunch and snacks from Schrankerl (sponsored by Storebox); complimentary coffee, tea, and fruit; regular team events; a modern office centrally located in the 5th district; an attractive benefits package (focusing on mobility or health); and many other employee perks. The gross annual salary starts at €62,000. Your actual remuneration will, of course, depend on your qualifications and experience and will be discussed with you personally.
